source_resolution.reason: The cited URL was fabricated: MIT 8.05 Quantum Physics II (Fall 2013) has no Chapter 4 titled 'The Time Evolution of a Quantum System'. The course's lecture notes are Chapters 1-3 Wave Mechanics, 3-4 Spin One-half and Bras/Kets, 5-8 Linear Algebra, 9 Dirac notation, 10-11 Uncertainty Principle, 12-16 Quantum Dynamics; the conservation laws used by this item (conservation of the norm under unitary evolution, conserved operators commuting with the Hamiltonian) sit in Chapter 6 'Quantum Dynamics' Sections 2.1 and 3.2, whose live OCW PDF was fetched and verified in full.
source_resolution.search_summary: Web search for the exact file name and for MIT 8.05 Fall 2013 lecture-note titles located the course's actual chapter list; the conservation-of-norm and conserved-operator statements were then read directly in the fetched Chapter 6 PDF (mutool text extraction, pp. 10-22). The originally cited Chapter 4 URL returns HTTP 404 on every attempt and no 8.05 F13 document of that title exists.

searches.query: MIT 8.05 Quantum Physics II Fall 2013 lecture notes Chapter 4 "Time Evolution" MIT8_05F13_Chap_04.pdf
searches.outcome: Returned the course's lecture list: chapters are Wave Mechanics (1-3), Spin One-half/Bras Kets (3-4), Linear Algebra (5-8), Dirac notation (9), Uncertainty Principle (10-11), Quantum Dynamics (12-16); no 'Time Evolution' chapter.

Only unofficial third-party references to an older OCW file naming; the authoritative OCW course pages link the chapter PDFs by hashed resource URLs, and the live Chapter 6 PDF 79a8091ef4f18d8e3ff76a097e8db33c_MIT8_05F13_Chap_06.pdf fetched with substantive full text.

alternatives.argument: The consumed content of the dropped source -- unitarity of the time-evolution operator, conservation of the norm, and 'an operator is conserved iff it commutes with the Hamiltonian' with constant expectation values -- is supplied by the replacement treatment MIT 8.05 F13 Chapter 6 'Quantum Dynamics' Sections 2.1 'Unitary time evolution' (pp. 10-17) and 3.2 'Heisenberg equation of motion' (pp. 20-22), read in full at the verified URL, and by the page's primary treatment Teschl Sections 3.1-3.3. The item's proof itself is unchanged and complete without the dropped URL: clauses (a')-(c) are proved from the spectral theorem items listed in deps.
